info.name: MiniPolya Backend
info.description:
Regression suite for the MiniPolya football-pitch booking API.

Setup
1. Start the app on http://localhost:8080 with the .env values exported.
2. Build initData for each test user and put it in the environment:
     BOT_TOKEN=... scripts/make-init-data.sh 900001 Player1 player1 uz
   Set the result as player1InitData, and likewise for player2/teamLeaderA/
   teamLeaderB/owner/admin (telegram ids 900001-900006).
3. Make the admin user an admin directly in the database:
     UPDATE users SET is_admin = true WHERE telegram_id = 900006;
4. Run the folders in order. Tokens and ids are captured into the environment
   as the run proceeds.

Never put BOT_TOKEN, JWT_SECRET or database passwords into Postman. initData is
a signed, short-lived artefact, so it is safe to paste; the bot token is not.

The "open" game type (individual players joining a public game) is deliberately
not covered.

Every request asserts the HTTP status, the { success, data, message } envelope
and the success flag. Requests named "Regression guard" cover bugs fixed on the
feature/endpoint-fix branch.
